Payment Consultations Memberships Shop Contact Book Now Modern, cutting-edge aesthetic treatments & techniques located in Waterville, Maine Meet the Aesthetic Team Stephanie McPherson, RN, BSN Founder & Lead Aesthetic Nurse Stephanie McPherson is a Registered Nurse with 19 years of clinical nursing experience and the founder of Peak Aesthetics. Her approach to aesthetics is rooted in medical integrity, patient safety, and long-term skin health—combining advanced clinical knowledge with an individualized, patient-first philosophy. Stephanie has invested extensively in advanced education in facial aesthetics, injectable treatments, laser skin rejuvenation, and corrective skin care. She is a Certified ZO Skin Health Specialist, with deep expertise in evidence-based skin correction and maintenance protocols designed to support healthy, resilient skin over time. In addition to leading Peak Aesthetics, Stephanie is a proud educator at DCCM Academy, where she trains and mentors aspiring aesthetic providers. Teaching allows her to remain closely connected to anatomy, technique, and evolving best practices—ensuring her clinical standards remain at the highest level. Stephanie is passionate about ethical aesthetics, ongoing education, and building trust through transparency and expertise. She believes aesthetic medicine should enhance confidence while preserving natural features and prioritizing patient safety at every stage. Stephanie invites patients to partner with her on a thoughtful, informed aesthetic journey—one built on experience, precision, and care. Education That Goes Beyond Certification Peak Aesthetics is built on structured, tier-based medical education. Stephanie has completed progressive levels of advanced training through DCCM Academy, earning recognition for continued mastery in anatomy, safety, and facial balancing. Amanda, Licensed Medical Aesthetician ZO® Certified Specialist | Medical Aesthetician Amanda is a Licensed Medical Aesthetician with a strong foundation in clinical skincare and a passion for helping clients achieve visible, long-term skin health. She is a Certified ZO Skin Health Specialist and ZO Expert, with advanced knowledge in corrective and maintenance-based skincare protocols tailored to each client’s unique needs. Amanda specializes in advanced skin assessments, pigment correction and acne-focused treatments, results-driven DiamondGlow® facials, laser hair removal, professional teeth whitening, and brow and lash services. Her approach emphasizes education, consistency, and evidence-based care—empowering clients to understand their skin and actively participate in their treatment plans. Her commitment to continued education, clinical excellence, and ethical aesthetics aligns seamlessly with the values of Peak Aesthetics. Known for her attention to detail, professionalism, and warm, approachable demeanor, Amanda creates a welcoming experience while maintaining the highest standards of care. Amanda is a natural fit for the Peak Aesthetics team. Her dedication to skin health, collaborative spirit, and genuine passion for aesthetics embody the elevated, patient-centered experience Peak is known for. Sam, RN Aesthetic Nurse | ZO® Specialist Sam is a Registered Nurse with a strong clinical foundation and a patient-first approach that aligns seamlessly with the philosophy at Peak Aesthetics. She began her medical career as a phlebotomist, where she developed exceptional technical skill, attention to detail, and comfort working closely with patients. From there, Sam built a solid background in emergency medicine, gaining experience in high-pressure environments that demand precision, safety, and calm decision-making. Sam has previously worked in medical aesthetics and has continued to deepen her expertise through advanced education. She is ZO® Certified and a dedicated ZO Specialist, with a strong focus on skin health, corrective protocols, and long-term results using ZO Skin Health. She has also completed advanced injector training at DCCM Academy, earning certification in dermal fillers and lip filler with an emphasis on anatomy, safety, and natural outcomes. Sam joined Peak Aesthetics with a genuine desire to continue learning, grow under mentorship, and provide thoughtful, individualized care. She shares Peak’s commitment to ongoing education, evidence-based treatments, and putting patients first—always. We are thrilled to welcome Sam to the Peak Aesthetics team and look forward to the expertise, compassion, and dedication she brings to every patient experience. Ashley, RN Aesthetic Nurse Ashley is a Registered Nurse with over 15 years of healthcare experience. Her clinical expertise, compassionate approach, and commitment to patient-centered care make her a valued member of the Peak Aesthetics team. Ashley provides a range of services at Peak Aesthetics, with a particular interest in medical weight management and body composition optimization. She is passionate about helping patients achieve meaningful, lasting results through personalized treatment plans and evidence-based care. Dedicated to promoting confidence, health, and overall well-being, Ashley looks forward to supporting patients throughout their aesthetic and wellness journey at Peak Aesthetics. About Peak Aesthetics We’re conveniently located in Waterville, Maine in a physicians complex. Our goal is to give you radiant, youthful looking skin both now and in the future, by creating custom treatment plans to address immediate concerns and slow the aging process over time. I’m committed to helping you feel and more confident and more comfortable in your own skin. To ensure smooth scheduling and respect for both our providers and other clients, please review and adhere to our cancellation policy . An Educator As a highly skilled Registered Nurse and provider at Peak Aesthetics, Stephanie also serves as an educator at the renowned DCCM Academy, where she mentors new injector students.
